annotations.title: Find Wikipedia articles citing a domain

description: List Wikipedia articles that reference the given domain. Read-only. One HTTPS GET to the Wikipedia API (en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=exturlusage). No auth required; no API keys; no rate limits beyond Wikipedia's public API fair-use policy (~1 request/second). Returns article titles and URLs. Wikipedia backlinks are the highest-lift signal for LLM training corpora — a domain cited from Wikipedia is far more likely to appear in AI training data and citation pools. Use lang to query non-English Wikipedias.

domain.description: Domain to search for, e.g. 'automatelab.tech' (without protocol).

name: signals_wikipedia

mentions.description: List of Wikipedia articles that cite the domain.

total.description: Number of Wikipedia articles referencing this domain.
